boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Rockhurst observances and recurring community practices, from service send-offs to a bagpipe-led graduation walk.

cards.title: Finucane Day of Service
cards.subtitle: Annual Rockhurst orientation service event
cards.notes: Join a service-and-fellowship project during orientation, alongside incoming and returning students, employees, and alumni.
cards.short_summary: Rockhurst’s annual orientation-day connection to Kansas City service.
cards.evidence_claim: Rockhurst defines Finucane Day of Service as an annual orientation event inviting incoming and returning students, employees, and alumni into service and fellowship with the Kansas City community.
cards.source_title: Campus Terminology – Catholic, Jesuit Tradition | Rockhurst University
cards.access_notes: Participation details are provided through Rockhurst orientation and Campus Ministry communications.

cards.title: Solidarity-Immersion Trips
cards.subtitle: Rockhurst service travel during academic breaks
cards.notes: Apply in September if eligible, then prepare to learn and work alongside host communities during a school-break immersion trip.
cards.short_summary: Annual break-time service and learning trips organized through Rockhurst.
cards.evidence_claim: Rockhurst describes Solidarity-Immersion Trips as annual winter, spring, and summer-break trips where students travel to work, learn, and laugh alongside hosts.
cards.source_title: Campus Terminology – Catholic, Jesuit Tradition | Rockhurst University
cards.access_notes: Rockhurst states that the application process starts each September; destinations and eligibility vary.

cards.title: Mass of the Holy Spirit
cards.subtitle: Opening-of-year Jesuit academic observance
cards.notes: Attend at the start of the academic year to reflect on shared purpose and the Jesuit values guiding the university community.
cards.short_summary: Rockhurst’s opening-of-year observance in a long Jesuit academic tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: Rockhurst reported that its Mass of the Holy Spirit marks the beginning of the academic year, when the community pauses in gratitude and recommits to its work and Jesuit core values.
cards.access_notes: Scheduling is announced by Rockhurst; the university describes this as an opening-of-year observance.

cards.title: World Cultures Day Prayer Service
cards.subtitle: October kickoff to Rockhurst’s culture celebration
cards.notes: Begin World Cultures Day by gathering for the university prayer service before the day’s countries, cultures, food, and music.
cards.short_summary: A prayerful opening to Rockhurst’s annual World Cultures Day.
cards.evidence_claim: Rockhurst states that each October the university begins its annual World Cultures Day celebration by praying together.
cards.access_notes: Rockhurst identifies this as an October observance; consult the campus calendar for the current date.

cards.title: Yom HaShoah
cards.subtitle: Annual Holocaust Remembrance Day observance
cards.notes: Take part respectfully in the name-reading and concluding interfaith prayer service honoring people murdered by the Nazis, including 152 Jesuits.
cards.short_summary: Rockhurst’s annual remembrance, centered on names and an interfaith prayer service.
cards.evidence_claim: Rockhurst annually commemorates Yom HaShoah by reading names of people murdered by the Nazis, including 152 Jesuits, and ending with an interfaith prayer service.
cards.access_notes: Dates and participation details are announced through Rockhurst Campus Ministry.

cards.title: Interfaith Panel
cards.subtitle: Annual Campus Ministry and SEEK conversation
cards.notes: Listen as students of different faith traditions discuss how their beliefs intersect with and differ from Rockhurst’s core values.
cards.short_summary: An annual student-faith conversation rooted in Rockhurst’s Ignatian heritage.
cards.evidence_claim: Rockhurst says Campus Ministry, SEEK Interfaith Council, and university departments annually sponsor an interfaith panel featuring students of varying faith traditions.
cards.access_notes: Campus Ministry presents this as an annual event; watch Rockhurst event listings for details.

cards.title: Diwali
cards.subtitle: SEEK Interfaith Council festival-of-lights observance
cards.notes: Join the campus observance to learn about Diwali and recognize the festival’s commemoration of the triumph of good over evil.
cards.short_summary: A Rockhurst SEEK Interfaith Council observance of the festival of lights.
cards.evidence_claim: Rockhurst lists Diwali among the annual events assisted by its SEEK Interfaith Council and describes it as a festival-of-lights celebration.
cards.access_notes: Event timing and format are set by Campus Ministry and SEEK Interfaith Council.

cards.title: Iftar
cards.subtitle: SEEK Interfaith Council Ramadan observance
cards.notes: Attend the campus Iftar to learn about the meal with which Muslims end their daily fast during the holy month of Ramadan.
cards.short_summary: A Rockhurst interfaith observance connected to Ramadan.
cards.evidence_claim: Rockhurst lists Iftar among annual events assisted by its SEEK Interfaith Council and identifies it as the evening meal ending Muslims’ daily Ramadan fast.
cards.access_notes: Event timing follows the campus calendar and Ramadan observance.

cards.title: ABC Eucharistic Adoration
cards.subtitle: Monthly Mabee Chapel prayer gathering
cards.notes: Drop in for adoration, benediction, confession, music, and a student reflection during the fall or spring semester gathering.
cards.short_summary: A monthly Rockhurst prayer gathering with reflection and music.
cards.evidence_claim: Rockhurst says ABC includes adoration, benediction, confession, praise and worship music, and a student reflection, and is offered on the second Tuesday of each month during fall and spring.
cards.access_notes: Rockhurst lists ABC for 7–9 p.m. on the second Tuesday of fall and spring months in Mabee Chapel; confirm current scheduling.

cards.title: Hawk Walk
cards.subtitle: Annual post-commencement procession to KC Live!
cards.notes: After commencement, follow the Rock E. Hawk and bagpipe-led procession to KC Live! for the official cap toss and welcome program.
cards.short_summary: Rockhurst graduates’ bagpipe-led march and official cap toss after commencement.
cards.evidence_claim: Rockhurst calls Hawk Walk its annual graduation tradition: graduates process in a Rock E. Hawk and bagpipe-led parade to KC Live! for an official cap toss.
cards.access_notes: Occurs immediately following Rockhurst commencement; graduates and invited family and friends participate.
